title: Relationship
description: An explicit link between two things a person works with — sources, annotations, thoughts, people, things, places, or events — with a record of where the link came from and who has authority over it.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's schema (semver: major.minor.patch).

from.description: The thing this link starts from.

to.description: The thing this link points to.

provenance.description: Where this link came from: made by the person, suggested by the system, imported from elsewhere.

authority.description: Who may change or remove this link.

refType.description: What kind of thing this endpoint is.

refId.description: Id of the thing this endpoint refers to.
